definitions.gloss: height of prosperity; heyday; peak; zenith
definitions.explanation: The period when something or someone is at the peak of power, popularity, or success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全盛期|ぜんせいき}→全盛期：11644_zenseiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全盛期|ぜんせいき}→全盛期：11644_zenseiki⟧だ。
examples.english: That singer is at the peak of their career right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧{全盛|ぜんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、あえて⟦ガラケー→ガラケー：08944_garakee⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Even in the age of smartphone dominance, some people deliberately use flip phones.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (complete, all) + {盛|せい} (prosperity, flourishing). Most commonly appears in the compound ⟦{全盛期|ぜんせいき}→全盛期：11644_zenseiki⟧ (heyday, golden age). Also used attributively as ～{全盛|ぜんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (the era of ～'s dominance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全盛期|ぜんせいき}→全盛期：11644_zenseiki⟧ (heyday, golden age)
- {全盛|ぜんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ (to reach the height of prosperity)
- ～{全盛|ぜんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (the era when ～ was dominant)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最盛期|さいせいき}→最盛期：13058_saiseiki⟧: peak period — very similar, emphasizes the absolute peak
- ⟦{絶頂|ぜっちょう}→絶頂：13844_zecchou⟧: peak, climax — the highest point, often used for emotions or power
